conventions.geometry_sha256: sha256(float64 world vertices + int64 loop-triangle indices), same formula as report source_sha256 in smart_lod.pipeline v0.1

roi_definition.use: evaluation only; never protection input for any simplification method
roi_definition.rule: vertex is inside ANY union term and NOT inside ANY exclude term; coordinates are normalised
roi_definition.area_fraction: integral over the surface of the linearly interpolated 0/1 vertex weight / total surface area (triangle area x mean corner membership)

categories.hard_surface: vehicle, product or CAD part with sharp edges
categories.character_face: face, bust or character whose face carries meaning
categories.organic: scan or animal with a complex silhouette

splits.rule: tuning assets choose lambda and channel weights; evaluation assets are never used for tuning
